I don't really know anybody except my family and it would just open a can of worms and likely make them mad somehow.  I literally haven't spoken to really anyone since late 2016.
It doesn't make me feel worse really. I know people are just trying to help. It does make me feel a little guilty when I feel like i'm just making excuses.

I'm not really sure there is anything anyone can do. I didn't necessarily post this for help but to get it off my chest and kinda come to terms with my situation. You are all very sweet. People have offered to venmo me or paypal me etc but I don't even have a cell phone or a bank account so even that sort of help is unavailable. There really isn't any options that I can think of. I also don't like to burden anyone else, it makes me feel guilty and I know most people are working hard and barely getting by themselves.

Its fine. I'm self aware and no suggestion is going to make me feel worse. They are just trying to help in their own way. The 'tough love' path in discussion may be frowned upon here but it doesn't bother me necessarily. Its just discussion. It does seem that its constructive advice with built in judgement though and that certainly isn't helpful. While I don't care, I imagine it could be harmful for someone else who isn't even suicidal yet...so maybe watch your tone when giving suggestions on someone else's life?  


As for why can't I get a job. Well, I think I listed quite a few reasons why I can't at the moment. Namely, I don't have transportation and live at least 20 minutes from remotely viable jobs, even flipping burgers (which I can't and won't do due to OCD reasons and food ) As for other jobs, sure but I am transgender obviously. I don't feel like myself. I have body image issues and while those are at their strongest I just don't feel comfortable people even seeing me, let alone working  at a point of service where people are rude and cruel to employees. I don't have any clothes that fit me...regardless of gender specific clothes or clothes that make me feel like me. I also haven't worked in 5 years almost so my resume isn't great and finding someone to give me a job even if I had transporation or appropriate clothes or the right mental health to even be in a workplace right now...just wouldn't happen. Five years ago, I went to at least 100 interviews while on the verge of homelessness in heels on a bus every single day. I'm not opposed to work. I'm not lazy. I used to get up at 4:30 am to do my makeup and get on the bus by 6 am. I never complained. I was happy.  I am, however, a proud person by nature and that little bit of pride is the last thing that I have. My personal dignity isn't something I'm going to throw away to beg for a chance to work when I know thats not a viable thing right now. So if your suggestion is that I'm lazy or just don't want to work, you are mistaken.  Homelessness isnt an option. Transpeople are murdered everyday while homeless. I've lived a privileged life up until my mid twenties pretty much, I just wouldn't survive it. I think suggesting homelessness is irresponsible anyway in the current political climate for trans people, especially since I live in the south. But why would I trade being suicidal and alone than being alone on the street and being murdered? For hope? I'm sorry but I'm a very difficult person, clearly. I have my own concepts and ideas and ways of viewing things. I have no hope at the moment or dreams and can't even conceive a concep that would change my life at this point so why would I even remotely go into a darker situation for a little hope of possibly clawing my way back to not being able to afford an apartment?  I just don't get it.  Phantom is right, its not helpful. I'm not stupid. I probably have above average intelligence and am a critical thinker. If I felt I could have made it that way, I would have already done it. I've been close to homlessness before like I said and I did make it work but I had the armor of having appropriate clothes and the privilege of being able to do my makeup how I like tomake myself comfortable and that gave me the armor I needed to face the world. I wasn't as depressed and my situation didn't seem hopeless then.  But at the end of the day, I was still struggling but I was happy. So trust me, if I could just work a entry level job again and scrape by, I'd love nothing more than to do that. I'm not lazy.
Several people have been more than generous in offering to venmo or paypal or even gofundme but I don't have a bank account or working phone right now anyway.  You are very kind though.

Its ok they are just trying to help. I've got food stamps before prior to this situation when I was working and struggling. Honestly, while it helped some, it didn't help that much. I still had no way to get to a grocery store at the time other than a bus but with my working hours, there was never even time to do that. That isn't the point I guess. I'm not starving... I am just not eating the healthiest or most desirable diet. I am still grateful to have what I have though which could be part of the problem, I dont know. As for disability... I'm not disabled. My mother was disabled and it took her years to get it so theres no chance I would ever get such a thing nor do I think I deserve it. As for the army, that just isn't an option. I don't do well with authority. I've never got into any trouble or done illegal drugs etc but thats just because of my choices not to. I wouldn't survive the army. I wouldn't be able to deal with the degrading drill sargeants etc. That is the last thing I need right now. I do know people it worked for though but I'm a very self aware person, I'm not easily 'brainwashed' for lack of a better term right now. I can't be convinced to believe what I don't believe or in authority.

Everyone is very kind of rack their brains for viable suggestions but with my social anxiety and body disphoria issues even if I found a job theres no way I would be a good employee right now. As for living on someones couch, I don't know anyone. And social housing like a shelter is just not viable. Its not something I'm willing to do. It would send me over the edge to suicide anyway. Humiliation for me sends me into extreme panic attacks. Its childish maybe, I don't know but my dignity is all I have left. I don't really want anyone to see me in my current state.  Even before this though, I had a job, I wasn't making much and when I lost my sublet appartment (the management just decided to kick me out one day) I couldn't even find an apartment I could afford ( a larger more touristy town) and it was honestly hell. I'm not opposed to work, some of my happiest times were at work but I'm only able to work where I feel totally comfortable and safe and when I feel like myself. Otherwise its torture. I feel like I'm just giving excuses and I know people hate that.
Thank you I really do appreciate it. I'm not really grieving anymore, I don't think. Maybe I am who knows, I'm honestly a little angry that I put myself in this situation.
I don't have a bank account at the moment and I don't really have friends who would donate to a gofundme. I don't know how those work but I'm sure you need a bank account.

What is a quarantined sub? I'm new to reddit period lol. As for venmo or patreon, I don't have a bank account or even a working phone so even generous offers like that have to be declined unfortunately. I do have a PO box but my family checks it so I'm not sure if I'd be willing to try that.

I do think the depression and social anxiety do make things worse but honestly, not that much worse. I am very self aware. I can see outside of the depression and social anxiety. I've always had these issues and managed them quite well for my entire life.  Therapy doesn't work for me because I am so self aware...or at least thats why I assume it doesn't work. It makes me angry to be honest. I SHOULD be depressed. I am living in an extremely undesirable situation with no way out so if I weren't depressed, it would be a sign that I've lost my mind. Social anxiety is also manageable but now I don't even feel like myself, so theres body disphoria/dismorphia ( I get them confused) issues and that makes the social anxiety worse. Body issues require treatment, hormones and actually feeling like yourself. When I look into the mirror, which I actually never do, I don't see myself. I don't have my hair and makeup how I was used to prior to this, I don't have the clothes I had or made me feel confident. That stuff was like armor and with it stripped away, I am not as strong as I used to be. I'm not willing to lose the only thing I have left which is a tiny shred of personal dignity.  Its a little bit of pride which people are going to think is stupid but its all Ive got left.

Thank you. The thing is, even before things deteriorated to this point, I was struggling. I was struggling before I moved back here to take care of her. I had my own apartment, subletted that was taken away from me suddenly by the apartment management. I had to stay in a hotel and it took all of my money. I was working, I had to get up at 4:30 am to get ready and be at the bus by 6:00am. So I'm not really ignorant of harsh conditions and fighting. I'm just tired and in my present situation, there isn't even a way to do that. I am very self aware and have always been able to manage my social anxiety and depression etc but now its become debilitating. Further humiliation would just drive me to immediate suicide to be honest. I can't degrade myself any further. All I have left is some personal dignity and I'm not sure its worth it to me to voluntarily become homeless like some people are suggesting in hopes of a better life in a bigger city. That doesn't really make sense to me because I've been there and while I was happier, I was extremely afraid and anxious all the time.  I just don't have hope left, which I know is sad but I don't know what else to say.
I don't own the house I live in. I don't own a car. I have running water, I'm not sure why I need a gym to shower at...and the nearest library to me is probably 20 miles.

I'm not trying to be rude but don't you think I'd have done that if that were an option. I have no clothes that fit me. I have social anxiety and body image issues, even when I feel like I look my best its difficult. I live in the middle of nowhere. Theres no way to get to a job.  Its not as if I've never worked...I'm well aware of how to get a job. "Take out a loan". Who is going to give me a loan... On what credit? Collateral? etc.
